summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py: a low-level print that converts objects with str(), joins them with sep, and applies only style and optional highlighting (no pretty-printing, wrapping, cropping, markup, or emoji). Added a CHANGELOG.md entry and three tests in tests/test_console.py. Tests were not run and nothing was committed. Docs in docs/source/console.rst, CONTRIBUTORS.md, and black formatting were not done.
